Replay tile state machine for blocks, votes, roots, leader slots, and FEC set processing.

# Purpose
This file defines the [`replay`](<#replay>) tile for the Firedancer runtime. It manages block replay from received shreds, snapshot data, genesis data, tower updates, PoH messages, and execution results. The code builds and maintains the replay state machine, including bank creation and finalization, fork tracking, root advancement, leader transitions, and publication of replay events to other tiles such as `exec`, `tower`, `poh`, `resolv`, `gui`, and `stake`. It also handles boot from genesis or snapshot, verifies shred version data, and keeps the account database, program cache, transaction cache, and reassembler in sync with replay progress.

The file also defines the tile setup and runtime integration code. It allocates and joins the replay tile state, configures input and output links, sets seccomp and file descriptor limits, and publishes metrics. Several helper functions translate between block IDs and bank indices, buffer and publish vote tower data, publish stake weights, and process completed FEC sets and execution task results. The `fd_tile_replay` descriptor at the end exposes this code as a runnable tile in the topology system.
